title: Operator billing pages in the CRM: profile, deployments, invoices, record a payment, allocate
description:
As an operator, I handle a client's billing from the account's page in the CRM admin workspace, where "Usage and billing" under Serve is a placeholder today (features/admin-workspace.feature).

Feature: Operator billing in the CRM
  Scenario: Account billing overview
    Given an operator with accounts:admin:read and accounts:admin:billing opening an account
    Then they see the billing profile, each site deployment's line with plan, status and period, open invoices with balances, recent payments, and the journal timeline
  Scenario: Read-only operator
    Given an operator with accounts:admin:read only
    Then the same view is shown and every action is disabled with the reason
  Scenario: Raise an invoice
    When the operator adds lines, picks a due date and issues the invoice via Stripe or manually
    Then the invoice appears with its number and balance and the chosen issue method
  Scenario: Record and allocate a payment
    When the operator records a check and allocates it across two invoices
    Then both balances update and the payment shows no remainder; an over-allocation is blocked in the form before the request
  Scenario: Reverse
    When the operator reverses a payment with a reason
    Then the reversal shows in the timeline with the actor
  Scenario: No customer data leaks
    Then billing contact fields are shown masked until revealed, and nothing billing-related is logged in the browser console

Done looks like: `src/admin/` views using the shared Kanbus/Virtuus UI components, Lucide icons (receipt, credit-card, landmark, banknote, history), buttons not dropdowns for actions, forms with integer-safe money inputs; staff BFF routes forwarding to the operator billing routes.

Data touched: read and write through the operator routes from the earlier stories; no new storage.

Specs: `features/billing-operator-ui.feature`; `test/billing-admin-ui.test.ts` and a Playwright flow in `test/browser/` against the fake processor.
